You run the streets of Granite City. Five years. One budget.

  1. Pick a street. Read its distress, PCI and traffic.
  2. Run an FWD test if you suspect the structure is weak. AASHTO 93 does the rest.
  3. Assign the right treatment at the right time, then close out the year.
  4. Your score: network PCI, decision quality, structural adequacy and value for money.
